lines.text: If one day, with the gentle breeze,
a thunderbolt falls from the sky,
and the earth gives way beneath your feet,
than the animals of the forest.
Four of them, from four sides,
will tear at you, devour you.
the helpless earth will fall silent.
You will lie lifeless, spent, naked,
nothing but a lump of flesh.
The moon will hide its face in the sky;
the stars will put on an act.
there will not be a shred of strength
to raise a hand, open your mouth and call.
Beating his chest, the monster will go on raping,
afraid of no one, of nothing.
No god or goddess will come down;
all those vows and fasts are only tales to soothe the mind.
From now on I will bind myself
to silence, a bond that will not break.
I will give up the spell
like the foot-scrubbing stone at the river steps,
and beats quietly, unable to speak...
What difference does it make to anyone
the cycle of seasons does not change,
collects in the hollows beneath my eyes,
and my trembling span of life...
After all those moments had passed,
there is nothing to gain here
except to lose one’s head for nothing—
this tangle of poison and nectar,
all of it is only swimming through mist,
of building a stairway to the sky—
to lose at the gamble of life
is the greatest bargain of all—
Parijat has fallen, scattered on the earth...

titles.title: Parijat Has Fallen to the Earth

lines.text: who, when this tired life falls apart,
would gather me in silent affection.
spreading her nectar-scent through the world.
At dawn the tired bud broke away;
golden morning came to ask after her.
If there were a shelter pure as earth,
this fragrance breathing through our lives
could find the shade of an earthly home.
To leave the branch is not the end,
but a new form of surrender.
Parijat’s falling is not in vain;
her shy grace clings to the earth.
Parijat holds fast to her faith:
the earth will take her to its breast,
Parijat has fallen, scattered on the earth.
Held close to it, she blooms anew.
Nor I will do read love poems any further
But it`s not easy for me
As a lover, I call myself,
Seas to skies, all that I know,
I have been in love with
I loved people, who returned me with pain
Scars I got in me, heartbroken, devastated
But, never had I stopped loving
Part of a love story, not that of hatred,
In quest of a friendly estuary
It does at the other end
In the heart of Amazon rainforest
Under the high heaven in September
Hills are decorated with green attire,
That, then, turn towards vast land
Fly and sit on red lilies,
Sometimes I wonder how that day will be,
When these two feet no longer touch your ground,
When your bright eyes no longer look for me,
And I am nowhere left here to be found.
How will it be, oh tell me,  how will it be?
Will there be rainbows arching through the plain?
Will there be sunshine singing just for me,
Or will the heavens only weep with rain?
Sometimes I spread my wings and soar away,

titles.title: When the Stars Forget My Name

lines.text: To wander valleys of an unseen land,
I rise and fall beneath the fading day,
And feel the rhythm of a guiding hand.
This gorgeous universe will spin the same,
But I still wonder how that night will be,
When stars no longer whisper out my name,
And silver moons no longer dream with me.
The grass will grow, the heavy tides will rise,
The world will turn without a single care,
But part of me will linger in your skies,
A quiet whisper in the evening air.
I was fierce when I was young,
I would lose my temper over little things.
but words did not come easily to me.
I would run out of words;
my fist would rise to the seventh heaven,
and my hands would take over.
Thus, in the innocence of youth,
I embraced the idea of non-violence.
and the mind became still water.
Waited and waited, so patiently waited..
For a metamorphosis, it can never see
Who has seen it  ? Who has seen it ?  It`s so ethereal even to feel it !
The dawn is humming, humming from the wings,
Give me a chance, give me a chance..
Palm full of bright, blinding rays flush  in
The wait is over  ! the wait is over !!
Here comes Atlas with  apples in hand,
Hercules smiles.. wipes sweat from head,
Thank you, dear. Thank you, dear. I could see you  at the tunnel end.
À wry smile, oh that wicked.. smile !
Spreads , into the black holes, spreads again ,
Free  bird  me, will fly away from pain !
Give me a break, give me a break !
Hercules  lowers it with clever grace,
Zooms merrily  away with no guilt trace..
And It`s  Atlas  again, it`s Atlas  again..
What a jolly mood of the fascinated bee that collects nectarean glee !
The reciprocating flowers hypnotized by their aerial love
Really a compromising canvas of love and beloved
Am often surprised , why this lunatic heart craves for an unknown one ?
Is this the blueprint of almighty or a natural instinct ?
As I have been mesmerized by his first celestial touch!
My novice soul filtered by his romantic osmosis
My tender heart penetrated by his deep serenity
We pitter-pattered bashfully in the molten rain
Alas! he disappeared like a shooting star ...
Hey flora and fauna !Please assure me,is he coming?
However, he has given me carved words!
Nor he can bulldoze my nostalgic emotions
Am waiting in this solitary forest with a ocean of hope
Let me wait till my fervent skin withers
Would remain loyal till my last breathe retires
Am stunk by smirks of critics and jealousness of lovelorn -souls
But am confident of the tremendous miracles of pure love
Neither trampled by knocking dust nor by momentary lust
O`my sweet palpitation! i gonna sip silent salvation
Before promising adieu, renew my golden intuition !!!
अगर कभी मंद मलय पवन के साथ
पाँवों के नीचे की धरती धँस जाए,
तेरे कुछ समझ पाने से पहले
तेरा तन पड़ा रहेगा—निर्जीव, निढाल, निर्वस्त्र,
आकाश में चाँद मुँह छिपा लेगा,
हाथ उठाकर, मुँह खोलकर पुकारने की
रत्ती भर ताकत भी नहीं होगी।
छाती ठोकता राक्षस बलात्कार करता रहेगा,
न किसी का डर, न भय।
सारे व्रत-उपवास बस मन बहलाने की कहानियाँ हैं।
एक अटूट नाता बाँध लेना है,
होंठों को मौन कर देना है।
दबाए हुए मरु की रेत की तरह,
नदी के घाट पर पैर घिसने के पत्थर की तरह
धुएँ के गुबार पर गुबार पीकर
मुझे बिल्कुल चुप हो जाना है।
न किसी की खिड़की के उस पार
मलय पवन का बहना रुकता है,
लोगों से खाली हो जाते हैं।
आँखों के नीचे के गड्ढों में
यहाँ बेवजह बावरा होने के सिवा
सब बस कुहरे में तैरना है,
ज़िंदगी के जुए में हार जाना ही
मौन स्नेह से गले लगा ले।
साँसों की इस सुरभित महक को,
शाखा से छूटना अंत नहीं है,
न आगे कभी प्रेम कविताएँ पढ़नी हैं।
पर मेरे लिए यह आसान नहीं,
प्रेम ही तो मेरी पहचान है।
समुद्र से आकाश तक, जो कुछ जाना,
जिन लोगों से प्रेम किया, उन्होंने दर्द लौटाया;
भीतर घाव मिले, दिल टूटा, सब उजड़ गया।
फिर भी प्रेम करना कभी नहीं छोड़ा,
क्योंकि प्रेम ही मेरी पहचान है।
किसी प्रेमकथा में रही है, नफ़रत की कथा में नहीं।
मुझमें प्रेम है, नफ़रत शायद ही कभी।
किसी आत्मीय मुहाने की तलाश में
वक्त के मुताबिक खेल खेलते हैं,
जिस पर सवार होकर हर इच्छा पूरी हो,
ओछे अहं और घमंड के जाल में—
जो सूखे जंगल की आग की तरह
AI कितनी दूर आगे बढ़ सकता है
किसी के अंतरतम को खोज निकालने में?
एकांत की नीरवता के लिए विलाप करता है,
जहाँ शहरी होती ज़िंदगी की लय
पहाड़ियों ने हरी पोशाक पहनी है,
खुली देहात की हवा के साथ
जो फिर मुड़ती है जल के
जिसमें लहराता आकाश और टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी पहाड़ियाँ झलकती हैं।
उड़ते हैं, लाल कुमुदों पर बैठते हैं,
और भी उत्सुक आँखें आती हैं
न गलने वाला कचरा छोड़ जाती हैं।
कभी सोच में पड़ जाता है मन—वह दिन कैसा होगा,
जब ये दोनों पाँव तुम्हारी ज़मीन नहीं छुएँगे,
जब तुम्हारी उजली आँखें मुझे नहीं ढूँढ़ेंगी,
और यहाँ कहीं मेरा पता नहीं होगा।
बताओ तो, कैसा होगा, वह दिन कैसा होगा?
क्या मैदान के ऊपर इंद्रधनुष झुकेंगे?
क्या धूप सिर्फ मेरे लिए गाएगी,
या आकाश बारिश बनकर रोता रहेगा?
कभी पंख फैलाकर दूर उड़ जाता है मन,
किसी अनदेखे देश की घाटियों में भटकने,

titles.title: जब तारे मेरा नाम भूल जाएँगे

lines.text: किसी राह दिखाते हाथ की लय को महसूस करने।
यह सुंदर ब्रह्मांड यूँ ही घूमता रहेगा,
पर अब भी मन पूछता है—वह रात कैसी होगी,
जब तारे मेरा नाम फुसफुसाना छोड़ देंगे,
और रुपहले चाँद मेरे साथ सपने नहीं देखेंगे।
पर मेरा कुछ अंश तुम्हारे आकाश में ठहरा रहेगा,
शाम की हवा में एक धीमी फुसफुसाहट।
जवानी में मेरा स्वभाव उग्र था,
छोटी-छोटी बातों पर गुस्सा आ जाता था।
पर शब्द आसानी से नहीं मिलते थे।
मेरी मुट्ठी सातवें आसमान तक उठ जाती,
और हाथ उसकी जगह ले लेते।
इस तरह, जवानी की नासमझी में,
अहिंसा के विचार को अपना लिया।
फिर उम्र अपने वन में दाखिल हुई,
और मन ठहरा हुआ पानी बन गया।
सिहरती फुसफुसाहट के साथ साँझ उतरती है,
बेचैन अहं बुझता है, बुझता जाता है,
शहर के बीच उदासी जम जाती है।
इंतज़ार किया, किया, कितने धीरज से किया...
उस कायांतरण का, जिसे वह कभी देख नहीं सकती।
किसने देखा है? किसने देखा है? महसूस करना भी कितना अलौकिक!
पंखों से भोर गुनगुना रही है,
एक मौका दो, एक मौका दो...
हथेली भर चमकीली, आँखें चौंधियाती किरणें उमड़ती हैं,
लो, हाथों में सेब लिए एटलस आ गया,
हरक्यूलिस मुस्कुराता है... माथे का पसीना पोंछता है,
शुक्रिया, प्रिय। शुक्रिया। सुरंग के उस छोर पर तुम दिखे।
एक टेढ़ी मुस्कान, ओह वह दुष्ट... मुस्कान!
उदासी उतरती है, फिर उतरती है,
फैलती है, काले विवरों में, फिर फैलती है,
मुक्त पंछी हूँ, इस पीड़ा से दूर उड़ जाना है!
ज़रा राहत दो, ज़रा राहत दो!
हरक्यूलिस चतुर सहजता से उसे नीचे रखता है,
बिना किसी अपराधबोध के खुशी-खुशी निकल जाता है...
और फिर एटलस ही, फिर एटलस ही...
कैसा मस्त है वह मुग्ध भौंरा, जो अमृत-सा उल्लास बटोरता है!
उत्तर देते फूल उस हवा में तैरते प्रेम से सम्मोहित हैं,
सचमुच प्रेम और प्रिय का एक समझौता करता चित्रपट।
अक्सर हैरानी होती है—यह पागल दिल किसी अनजाने के लिए क्यों तड़पता है?
क्या यह परमात्मा की रूपरेखा है या स्वाभाविक वृत्ति?
उसके पहले दिव्य स्पर्श ने जैसे मुझे सम्मोहित कर दिया!
मेरी अनभिज्ञ आत्मा उसके प्रेम के परासरण से छन गई,
उसकी गहरी शांति मेरे कोमल हृदय में उतर गई।
पिघली बारिश में हम लजाते हुए टप-टप चले,
हाय! वह टूटते तारे की तरह गायब हो गया...
ओ वनस्पतियो और जीवो! भरोसा दिलाओ, क्या वह आ रहा है?
कहीं तुम दिखावा तो नहीं कर रहे!
फिर भी, उसने मुझे उकेरे हुए शब्द दिए हैं!
वह मुझे धोखा नहीं दे सकता, कभी नहीं,
न मेरी स्मृतिभरी भावनाओं को बुलडोज़र से रौंद सकता है।
इस निर्जन वन में आशा का समुद्र लिए मेरी प्रतीक्षा जारी है।
मेरी तपती त्वचा मुरझा जाए, तब तक प्रतीक्षा करने दो,
आखिरी साँस विदा होने तक निष्ठा बनी रहेगी।
आलोचकों की कुटिल मुस्कानों और प्रेम-वंचित आत्माओं की ईर्ष्या ने डसा है मुझे,
पर निर्मल प्रेम के विराट चमत्कारों पर मेरा विश्वास है।
प्रेम हमारी सीमाओं से परे है!!!
भ्रमों से भरी कल्पनाओं के बाहर!!!
मेरा प्रेम पूरी तरह दिव्य है,
न दस्तक देती धूल से रौंदा हुआ, न क्षणिक वासना से।
हर पल मेरी सिसकी उठती है,
उसकी चंचल अनुपस्थिति मुझे क्षीण करती है।
ओ मेरी मीठी धड़कन! मुझे मौन मुक्ति का घूँट पीना है,
विदा का वचन देने से पहले मेरी सुनहरी अंतःप्रतीति फिर जगा दो!!!
କାହାରିକୁ ନାହିଁ ତାର ଡର ଅବା ଭୟ
ସବୁ ବ୍ରତ ଉପବାସ କେବଳ ମନଭୁଲା କାହାଣୀ ।
କିନ୍ତୁ ମୋ ପାଇଁ ଏତେ ସହଜ ନୁହେଁ,
ଭିତରେ କ୍ଷତ ନେଇ, ଭଙ୍ଗା ହୃଦୟରେ, ଉଜୁଡ଼ିଯାଇଛି।
ଯେଉଁଠି ଦୋଳେ ଆକାଶ ଓ ଅଙ୍କାବଙ୍କା ପାହାଡ଼।
ବେଳେବେଳେ ଭାବେ, ସେ ଦିନ କେମିତି ହେବ,
ଯେବେ ଏ ଦୁଇ ପାଦ ଆଉ ତୁମ ମାଟି ଛୁଇଁବେନି,
ତୁମ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ ଆଖି ଆଉ ମୋତେ ଖୋଜିବେନି,
ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଏଠି କେଉଁଠି ବି ମିଳିବିନି।
କେମିତି ହେବ, କୁହ ତ, କେମିତି ହେବ?
ପ୍ରାନ୍ତର ଉପରେ କି ଇନ୍ଦ୍ରଧନୁ ବଙ୍କେଇ ରହିବ?
କେବଳ ମୋ ପାଇଁ କି ଖରା ଗୀତ ଗାଇବ,
ନା ଆକାଶ କେବଳ ବର୍ଷା ହୋଇ କାନ୍ଦିବ?
ଢଳୁଥିବା ଦିନ ତଳେ ଉଠେ ଆଉ ଖସେ,
ବାଟ କଢ଼ାଉଥିବା ହାତଟିଏର ଛନ୍ଦ ଅନୁଭବ କରେ।
ତଥାପି ଭାବେ, ସେ ରାତି କେମିତି ହେବ,
ଯେବେ ତାରା ଆଉ ମୋ ନାଁ ଫୁସ୍‌ଫୁସ୍‌ କରିବେନି,
ରୁପେଲି ଜହ୍ନମାନେ ମୋ ସହ ସପନ ଦେଖିବେନି।
ଦୁନିଆ ଘୂରୁଥିବ କିଛି ଖାତିର ନ କରି,
କିନ୍ତୁ ମୋର କିଛି ଅଂଶ ତୁମ ଆକାଶରେ ରହିଯିବ,
ସଞ୍ଜ ପବନରେ ଏକ ନୀରବ ଫୁସ୍‌ଫୁସ୍‌ ହୋଇ।
ଅପେକ୍ଷା କଲା, କଲା, କେତେ ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ କଲା...
ସେଇ ରୂପାନ୍ତର ପାଇଁ, ଯାହା ସେ କେବେ ଦେଖିପାରିବନି।
କିଏ ଦେଖିଛି? କିଏ ଦେଖିଛି? ଅନୁଭବ କରିବା ବି କେତେ ଅଲୌକିକ!
ପାପୁଲିଏ ଉଜ୍ଜ୍ୱଳ, ଆଖି ଝଲସା କିରଣ ଭରିଯାଏ,
ଏଇ ଆସିଲା ଆଟଲାସ୍, ହାତରେ ସେଓ ନେଇ,
ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ପ୍ରିୟ। ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ସୁଡ଼ଙ୍ଗ ଶେଷରେ ତୁମକୁ ଦେଖିପାରିଲି।
ବଙ୍କା ହସଟିଏ, ଆହା ସେଇ ଦୁଷ୍ଟ... ହସ!
ମୁକ୍ତ ପକ୍ଷୀ ମୁଁ, ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାରୁ ଦୂରକୁ ଉଡ଼ିଯିବି!
ଟିକେ ଅବକାଶ ଦିଅ, ଟିକେ ଅବକାଶ ଦିଅ!
ହରକ୍ୟୁଲିସ୍ ଚତୁର ସହଜତାରେ ତାକୁ ତଳେ ରଖେ,
ଆଉ ପୁଣି ସେଇ ଆଟଲାସ୍, ପୁଣି ସେଇ ଆଟଲାସ୍...
କି ମଉଜରେ ଅଛି ମୁଗ୍ଧ ଭଅଁର, ଅମୃତମୟ ଆନନ୍ଦ ସାଉଁଟୁଛି!
ସାଡ଼ା ଦେଉଥିବା ଫୁଲ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଉଡ଼ନ୍ତା ପ୍ରେମରେ ସମ୍ମୋହିତ,
ସତରେ ପ୍ରେମ ଓ ପ୍ରିୟର ଏକ ବୁଝାମଣାର ଚିତ୍ରପଟ।
ପ୍ରାୟ ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଲାଗେ, ଏ ପାଗଳ ହୃଦୟ କାହିଁକି କାହା ଅଚିହ୍ନା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟାକୁଳ?
ଏ କି ସର୍ବଶକ୍ତିମାନଙ୍କ ନକ୍ସା, ନା ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତି?
ତା’ର ପ୍ରଥମ ଦିବ୍ୟ ସ୍ପର୍ଶରେ ମୁଁ ଯେ ସମ୍ମୋହିତ!
ତା’ର ପ୍ରେମର ଅଭିସ୍ରବଣରେ ମୋ ଅନଭିଜ୍ଞ ଆତ୍ମା ଛାଣିହୋଇଗଲା,
ତା’ର ଗଭୀର ପ୍ରଶାନ୍ତି ମୋ କୋମଳ ହୃଦୟରେ ପଶିଗଲା।
ତରଳିଥିବା ବର୍ଷାରେ ଆମେ ଲାଜେ ଲାଜେ ଟପ୍‌ଟପ୍‌ ଚାଲିଲୁ,
ହାୟ! ଖସୁଥିବା ତାରା ପରି ସେ ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ହୋଇଗଲା...
ହେ ଗଛଲତା, ହେ ପଶୁପକ୍ଷୀ! ଭରସା ଦିଅ, ସେ କି ଆସୁଛି?
ତଥାପି ସେ ମୋତେ ଖୋଦିତ ଶବ୍ଦ ଦେଇଛି!
ସେ ମୋତେ ଠକିପାରିବନି, କେବେ ବି ନୁହେଁ,
କି ମୋ ସ୍ମୃତିଭରା ଆବେଗକୁ ବୁଲ୍‌ଡୋଜରରେ ମାଡ଼ିଦେଇପାରିବନି।
ମୁଁ ଏ ନିର୍ଜନ ବନରେ ଆଶାର ସମୁଦ୍ର ନେଇ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିଛି,
ମୋର ଉତ୍ତପ୍ତ ଚର୍ମ ମଉଳିବା ଯାଏ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବାକୁ ଦିଅ,
ଶେଷ ନିଃଶ୍ୱାସ ବିଦାୟ ନେବା ଯାଏ ନିଷ୍ଠା ରଖିବି।
ସମାଲୋଚକଙ୍କ ବିଦ୍ରୂପ ହସ ଓ ପ୍ରେମବଞ୍ଚିତ ପ୍ରାଣଙ୍କ ଈର୍ଷ୍ୟା ମୋତେ ଦଂଶିଛି,
ତଥାପି ନିର୍ମଳ ପ୍ରେମର ବିପୁଳ ଚମତ୍କାରରେ ମୋର ବିଶ୍ୱାସ।
ନା ମାଡ଼ିଆସୁଥିବା ଧୂଳିରେ ଦଳିତ, ନା କ୍ଷଣିକ କାମନାରେ।
ହେ ମୋର ମଧୁର ହୃଦ୍‌ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ! ମୁଁ ନୀରବ ମୁକ୍ତିକୁ ଚୁମୁକେ ପିଇବି,
ବିଦାୟର ବଚନ ଦେବା ଆଗରୁ ମୋ ସୁନେଲି ଅନ୍ତର୍ବୋଧକୁ ପୁଣି ଜଗାଇଦିଅ!!!
କାହାରିକୁ ନାହିଁ ତାର ଡର ଅବା ଭୟ
ସବୁ ବ୍ରତ ଉପବାସ କେବଳ ମନଭୁଲା କାହାଣୀ ।
मौन स्नेह से गले लगा ले।
साँसों की इस सुरभित महक को,
शाखा से छूटना अंत नहीं है,
Nor I will do read love poems any further
But it`s not easy for me
As a lover, I call myself,
Seas to skies, all that I know,
I have been in love with
I loved people, who returned me with pain
Scars I got in me, heartbroken, devastated
But, never had I stopped loving
Part of a love story, not that of hatred,
In quest of a friendly estuary
It does at the other end
In the heart of Amazon rainforest
Under the high heaven in September
Hills are decorated with green attire,
That, then, turn towards vast land
Fly and sit on red lilies,
Sometimes I wonder how that day will be,
When these two feet no longer touch your ground,
When your bright eyes no longer look for me,
And I am nowhere left here to be found.
How will it be, oh tell me,  how will it be?

titles.title: When the Stars Forget My Name

lines.text: Will there be rainbows arching through the plain?
Will there be sunshine singing just for me,
Or will the heavens only weep with rain?
Sometimes I spread my wings and soar away,
To wander valleys of an unseen land,
I rise and fall beneath the fading day,
And feel the rhythm of a guiding hand.
This gorgeous universe will spin the same,
But I still wonder how that night will be,
When stars no longer whisper out my name,
And silver moons no longer dream with me.
The grass will grow, the heavy tides will rise,
The world will turn without a single care,
But part of me will linger in your skies,
A quiet whisper in the evening air.
I was fierce when I was young,
I would lose my temper over little things.
but words did not come easily to me.
I would run out of words;
my fist would rise to the seventh heaven,
and my hands would take over.
Thus, in the innocence of youth,
I embraced the idea of non-violence.
and the mind became still water.
Waited and waited, so patiently waited..
For a metamorphosis, it can never see
Who has seen it  ? Who has seen it ?  It`s so ethereal even to feel it !
The dawn is humming, humming from the wings,
Give me a chance, give me a chance..
Palm full of bright, blinding rays flush  in
The wait is over  ! the wait is over !!
Here comes Atlas with  apples in hand,
Hercules smiles.. wipes sweat from head,
Thank you, dear. Thank you, dear. I could see you  at the tunnel end.
À wry smile, oh that wicked.. smile !
Spreads , into the black holes, spreads again ,
Free  bird  me, will fly away from pain !
Give me a break, give me a break !
Hercules  lowers it with clever grace,
Zooms merrily  away with no guilt trace..
And It`s  Atlas  again, it`s Atlas  again..
What a jolly mood of the fascinated bee that collects nectarean glee !
The reciprocating flowers hypnotized by their aerial love
Really a compromising canvas of love and beloved
Am often surprised , why this lunatic heart craves for an unknown one ?
Is this the blueprint of almighty or a natural instinct ?
As I have been mesmerized by his first celestial touch!
My novice soul filtered by his romantic osmosis
My tender heart penetrated by his deep serenity
We pitter-pattered bashfully in the molten rain
Alas! he disappeared like a shooting star ...
Hey flora and fauna !Please assure me,is he coming?
However, he has given me carved words!
Nor he can bulldoze my nostalgic emotions
Am waiting in this solitary forest with a ocean of hope
Let me wait till my fervent skin withers
Would remain loyal till my last breathe retires
Am stunk by smirks of critics and jealousness of lovelorn -souls
But am confident of the tremendous miracles of pure love
Neither trampled by knocking dust nor by momentary lust
O`my sweet palpitation! i gonna sip silent salvation
Before promising adieu, renew my golden intuition !!!
